title: Right Tool, Right Job: Native-Language Evaluation, Tokenizer Sensitivity, and Methodological Findings from a French-Only BabyLM
abstract: arXiv:2609.17435v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We submit M\'eTRON-FR, a 125M GPT-2 pretrained on 92.47M words of French, to the BabyLM 2026 Strict track. It scores 85.97 +/- 0.17% on QFrBLiMP (a native Quebec-French benchmark of grammatical minimal pairs) and 62.80% on the BabyLM-weighted leaderboard. A cross-lingual GLUE (General Language Understanding Evaluation) protocol that combines French task-data translation with rank-16 LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) produces a sharp task-type gradient: relational tasks gain measurably, while world-knowledge tasks regress. Bilingual Lexicon Induction aligns the French embeddings to GPT-2 at p@1 = 68.84 +/- 8.61%, 18X above chance, suggesting cross-lingual alignment tracks acquired grammatical competence rather than training duration. translated_title: 正确的工具，正确的任务：来自纯法语BabyLM的母语评估、分词器敏感性与方法学发现
translated_abstract: 我们将MÉTRON-FR——一个在9247万法语单词上预训练的1.25亿参数GPT-2模型——提交至BabyLM 2026严格赛道。它在QFrBLiMP（一个基于魁北克法语语法最小对立对的母语基准）上得分85.97 ± 0.17%，在BabyLM加权排行榜上得分62.80%。一种结合法语任务数据翻译与秩16 LoRA（低秩适配）的跨语言GLUE协议产生了显著的任务类型梯度：关系型任务获得了可测量的提升，而世界知识类任务则出现退化。双语词典归纳实验将法语词嵌入与GPT-2对齐，p@1达到68.84 ± 8.61%，是随机水平的18倍，这表明跨语言对齐反映的是模型习得的语法能力，而非训练时长。消融研究显示，在儿童语料规模下，单标记零样本评分主要受分词器和提示模板的伪影主导，这促使我们采用分词器替换敏感性分析、安慰剂对照提示以及母语基准评估等方法。
tldr: 本文通过纯法语训练的1.25亿参数GPT-2模型发现：跨语言对齐程度反映的是模型习得的语法能力而非训练时长，且小规模模型的单标记零样本评估严重受分词器与模板伪影影响，因此语法评估应使用母语基准而非英语翻译任务。
en_tdlr: Using a French-only 125M GPT-2, this paper finds that cross-lingual alignment reflects acquired grammatical competence rather than training duration, and that single-token zero-shot evaluation at child scale is dominated by tokenizer and template artifacts, motivating native-language benchmark evaluation.
